## WS-NODE-ANDROID — Android edge micro-node over CDC-NCM USB tethering
<!--
id: WS-NODE-ANDROID
title: Android edge micro-node over CDC-NCM USB tethering
theme: Fleet & Federation
status: proposed
priority: P2
laws: [1, 7, 8, 9, 14]
ssot_keys: ["containers.mios-node", "blade.discovery"]
adr: [16, 20]
deps: [WS-NODE, WS-BLADE, WS-MINI]
acceptance: |
  An Android handset attached over USB enumerates as a CDC-NCM interface, runs an AArch64 mios-node built by CI, answers mDNS on the tethered link only, executes Wasm tasks on-device, reconciles its task ledger across unplug/replug, and drains its work when the handset gets hot or low on charge.
-->

Nothing Android-facing exists in the tree today: no tether tooling, no AArch64 target, no
`[edge.*]` SSOT table, and no task or workstream had claimed the ground before this one. The
substrate this builds on is real — `src/mios-rs/mios-node/src/protocol.rs` implements the
16-byte header and `MIOS_PORT_NODE` is already allocated at 8650 — so this workstream is the
transport, the target triple, and the honesty repairs, not a new mesh.

**Corrections carried in from the source research (do not re-import the originals):**
- USB product ID `0x4EE3` is **RNDIS**, not "NCM + ADB". Google's NCM IDs are `18d1:4eeb`
  (NCM) and `18d1:4eec` (NCM + ADB), which is what a udev rule must match.
- Mainline has **not** removed or blacklisted `rndis_host`. Removal has been proposed
  repeatedly since 2022 and never merged; `CONFIG_USB_NET_RNDIS_HOST` is still a plain
  tristate. Prefer NCM on its merits (aggregation, macOS/Windows class drivers), not on a
  deprecation that has not happened.
- The stock AOSP RNDIS instance is `rndis.gs4`, not `rndis.gs7`, and Android's own init
  unbinds by writing `none` to `UDC` rather than an empty string.
- In-box auto-binding for `UsbNcm.sys` is a **Windows 11** property; Windows 10 shipped the
  binary but did not bind it to NCM devices without a manual INF.
- NCM-by-default is a **Tensor Pixel (Pixel 6+, Android 12 Gadget HAL v1.2)** property, not
  an AOSP-wide default; the tether function stays a per-vendor choice.
- PRoot's cost is not a flat "20-40%": it is `ptrace` on every syscall, which is tens of
  percent on compute and several-fold on syscall-dense I/O.
- The process assassin on Android 12+ is the **phantom process killer**, which a foreground
  service does not stop; it needs the `max_phantom_processes` device-config escape.
- MiOS ports are allocated, not chosen: the source cited `:11450`/`:11441`/`:8080` and
  Postgres `:5432`. The real values are `llm_light` 8500, `vllm` 8520, `sglang` 8530,
  `pgvector` 8600, `agent_pipe` 8700 (which is `MIOS_AI_ENDPOINT`), `node` 8650. Three of the
  cited ports are in `[docs].retired_ports`.

title: CDC-NCM gadget orchestration and host link bring-up  **[P2]**  (→ task_920)

details.why: The link is the precondition for every other item, and it is the one place where a wrong constant (the `0x4EE3` in the source document) silently produces an RNDIS link that no macOS host can use.

extra.value: Add `mios-tether-android` to negotiate the USB function (report, and optionally switch, `rndis.gs4` → an NCM instance) and a udev rule that brings the host side up when `18d1:4eeb`/`18d1:4eec` appears. Introduce `[edge.android_tether]` in the SSOT **with its consumer in the same change** — addresses, interface name and protocol preference are read from it, never written as literals.

Attaching a Pixel-class handset yields an `usb0` carrying the SSOT-declared address; a handset that enumerates as RNDIS is **reported as degraded**, not silently accepted; no IP, interface name or product ID appears as a literal in the script.

title: Wireless join over the Blade mesh AP; the cable becomes the enrolment channel  **[P2]**  (→ task_936)

details.why: A phone tethered to a Blade by a cable is a slower USB accelerator. A phone that enrols over the cable once and then works over the mesh is an edge node, which is the thing the workstream is named for. It also removes the single most awkward property of the current design: that the handset must stay physically attached to a machine that is itself supposed to be a headless box in a rack.

extra.value: task_3262..task_3267 are entirely cable-bound, which makes the edge node a peripheral rather than a node. WS-MINI establishes that **every MiOS-Metal Blade is its own AP forming one mesh Wi-Fi**, so the handset already has a network to join. Split the two paths by what each is actually good at: **USB is the out-of-band enrolment channel** — physically authenticated by the act of plugging in, and the only channel that exists before the device has credentials — and **Wi-Fi over the Blade mesh is the operational path**, so the node keeps working in a pocket. `[edge.android_tether]` gains a peer `[edge.android_wifi]`, and the node's link state becomes a first-class thing it reports rather than an assumption baked into the transport.

A handset enrolled over USB rejoins over Wi-Fi after unplug with no re-enrolment; the mDNS responder from task_3264 answers on the tether **or** the mesh link and on no other interface; and a node that has never been enrolled over the cable cannot join over Wi-Fi at all.

- **Accept:** A handset enrolled over USB rejoins over Wi-Fi after unplug with no re-enrolment; the mDNS responder from task_3264 answers on the tether **or** the mesh link and on no other interface; and a node that has never been enrolled over the cable cannot join over Wi-Fi at all.
- **Deps:** `task_3264`, `task_3271`, WS-MINI task_929.

title: Survive Android's process lifecycle, or admit the node is unreliable  **[P1]**  (→ task_937)

details.why: This is the difference between an edge node and an edge node that works. The correction is already recorded at the top of this workstream — the phantom killer, not a foreground-service limitation — but no item owned it, so the design still assumes a process that stays alive. A node that can be SIGKILLed at any moment without the fleet noticing strands whatever DAG depended on it.

extra.value: Android 12+ runs a **phantom process killer**: forked child processes are counted against a limit that defaults to **32 across the whole system** — not per app — and the excess is SIGKILLed. This is why Termux-hosted workloads die with `[Process completed (signal 9)]` at seemingly random intervals, and a foreground service does not prevent it. The documented escape is `device_config put activity_manager max_phantom_processes <large>` plus `settings put global settings_enable_monitor_phantom_procs false`, which requires **adb or root** — a one-time provisioning step, not something the node can do for itself. Three things follow and all three belong in the tree rather than in a wiki: perform that provisioning **while the cable is attached** (task_3268's enrolment moment is exactly when adb is available); **keep the node's own process count near one**, because every child it forks is drawn from a budget shared with every other app on the phone; and **detect that it was killed** and re-establish rather than silently vanishing from the fleet.

Enrolment reports whether the phantom-process escape was applied and the node advertises itself as **degraded** when it was not, rather than presenting as healthy and dying later; the node's steady-state child-process count is asserted by a test; and a SIGKILLed node is observed missing by the fleet within a bounded interval.

title: On-device inference that does not mortgage Law 5  **[P2]**  (→ task_938)

details.why: The handset's accelerator is the reason to put a node on it at all, and the cheapest way to lose the whole sovereignty thesis is to reach it through a hosted vendor runtime. Choosing llama.cpp keeps the edge node inside the existing endpoint contract; choosing AICore would put a cloud-adjacent vendor model inside an OS whose premise is that it has none.

extra.value: Decide the Android inference path deliberately, because the obvious one is a trap. **NNAPI was deprecated in Android 15**, so it is not a foundation to build on. The vendor-blessed successors split: **LiteRT** (shipped in Play Services) and **AICore/Gemini Nano** are the Google path, and AICore in particular is a **vendor-coupled hosted-model dependency** that Law 5 (UNIFIED-AI-REDIRECTS) does not permit — every agent and tool targets `MIOS_AI_ENDPOINT`, and no vendor-specific model product belongs in the tree. The path that costs MiOS nothing architecturally is the one it already ships: **`llama.cpp` with the same GGUF and the same OpenAI `/v1` surface as `mios-llm-light`**, so an Android edge node is a *lane* like any other and the router does not learn a new protocol to reach it. **ExecuTorch** (QNN / MediaTek backends, XNNPACK CPU fallback) is the considered alternative *only* where a specific NPU is worth the coupling, and that trade is recorded rather than assumed.

The handset answers `/v1/models` and serves a chat completion from a GGUF the fleet already bakes; NNAPI appears nowhere; an ADR records why AICore/Gemini Nano was rejected on Law 5 grounds and under what conditions ExecuTorch would be adopted instead.

title: A device identity the handshake actually implements  **[P1]**  (→ task_939)

details.why: An Android handset is the least physically-controlled member of the fleet — it leaves the building, it gets lost, it runs other people's apps. It is the member whose credential most needs to be revocable and least deserves to be the same secret everyone else holds. And the current module's docstring is a claim its code does not support, which is the same defect class as the decorative keys task_277 found: it reads as solved.

extra.value: `usr/libexec/mios/node/discovery.py` advertises "Avahi/mDNS zero-conf with an **Ed25519 handshake**" while opening no socket and using a **symmetric HMAC**. task_3264 replaces the socket half; this item owns the identity half, because a shared symmetric secret is not an identity — every node that can verify a peer can also impersonate one, which is precisely the property a fleet admitting pocket-sized hardware cannot afford. Give each edge node a real asymmetric device identity, enrolled over the USB cable (the one channel authenticated by physical possession), and bind it to the existing agent-passport / A2A identity surface rather than inventing a second trust root.

Enrolment provisions a per-device keypair whose private half never leaves the handset; a peer holding only public material can verify but not impersonate; revoking one device does not require re-keying the fleet; and the docstring matches the implementation, in whichever direction is made true.

## task_3300 — Pod consolidation (WS-C) — the main one (DONE)

Goal: collapse standalone containers into 7 capability pods, minimize the external
port surface, all driven from the EXISTING `tools/generate-pod-quadlets.py` (which
already reads `[pods.*]` and renders only `mios-webtools.pod` today).

### 1a (do FIRST, standalone) — code-server `:8080` → `:8800`
- `usr/share/containers/systemd/mios-code-server.container`: set `Environment=BIND_ADDR=0.0.0.0:8800` **and** add the entrypoint arg override `--bind-addr 0.0.0.0:8800` (the image ENTRYPOINT wins over the env var — it MUST be at the arg layer), update the 3 `:8080` Labels + header comment to `:8800`. `[ports].code_server=8800` already matches.
- **Accept:** `ss -ltnp | grep 8800` binds; `:8080` is free; editor reachable. This unblocks all pod co-residency (it's the lone live `:8080` squatter).

### 1b — Add the `[pods.*]` SSOT blocks to `mios.toml` (the `[pods.*]` section ONLY)
Mirror `[pods.mios-webtools]`'s schema (`description / network / after / wants / wanted_by / members[] / doc`). Create:
- `[pods.mios-ai-inference]` — members: `mios-llm-light` (+ `mios-cpu-node`◇, `mios-llm-worker@`◇)
- `[pods.mios-ai-heavy]`◇ — `mios-llm-heavy`, `mios-llm-heavy-alt`
- `[pods.mios-ai-data]` — `mios-pgvector`
- `[pods.mios-devforge]` — `mios-forge`, `mios-forgejo-runner`, `mios-code-server`
- `[pods.mios-netinfra-dns]` — `mios-adguard`
- `[pods.mios-remote-desktop]`◇ — `mios-guacamole`, `mios-guacd`, `mios-guacamole-postgres`
Keep `mios-webtools`. Leave `mios-open-webui` + `mios-searxng` **standalone** (front door / lifecycle).

### 1c — `Pod=` membership on each member `.container` + render
Add `Pod=<pod>.pod` to each member `.container`; run `python3 tools/generate-pod-quadlets.py` to render the new `.pod` quadlets; `systemctl daemon-reload`.
- **Accept:** `generate-pod-quadlets.py --check` → no drift; `podman pod ls` shows the pods (the un-gated ones) Running with their members; every health check green. **Hard constraints:** two containers in one pod may NOT bind the same port; `mios-ai-data` (pgvector :5432) must NOT co-pod with `mios-guacamole-postgres` (also :5432). The AI **brains** (hermes-agent, agent-pipe, mcp, prefilter, opencode-gateway, hermes-browser, ttyd) are **host services — leave them host-native**, pods reach them via `host.containers.internal`.

### 1d — Port minimization
De-publish `mios-searxng` (port key `searxng`) to loopback (it's consumed only by host hermes); drop `mios-llm-heavy-alt`'s stray `PublishPort=...:11440`. Target: ~24 raw host binds → ~8 deliberate front doors.

title: SYSTEMPROFILE-DESKTOP -- Modal error on MiOS-Xbox: `C:\WINDOWS\system32\config\systemprofile\desktop is not accessible. Access is denied.` A process running as SYSTEM/systemprofile touches a non-existent Desktop folder. Fix: pre-create `%WINDIR%\System32\config\systemprofile\Desktop` (+ SysWOW64 mirror) in provisioning, AND/OR run the offending step (SetupComplete/task/service) as the interactive user not SYSTEM. **Done-when:** no such modal on boot/login.

title: XBOX-ACCOUNT-FLOW -- WRONG account+setup order: MiOS setup runs AFTER a visible desktop, logged into an auto-created `User` (User/user) account -- NOT the intended `MiOS-Sudo` (built-in Administrator). title: TWINFIX-01 -- check_resolver_twin_parity was a SELF-COMPARISON, not a vacuous fixture. Its Python leg read `section(load_merged())` (the raw merged table, not the resolver), and its bash leg ran userenv.sh, which under `env -i` with no native binary on PATH falls through tiers 1-2 to tier 3 -- mios_toml.py. PROVEN by mutation: disabling resolve_cross_references in mios_toml.py changed the BASH leg's output, and the check still passed. FIXED: Python leg now calls emit_exports() (the twin Law 13 names); the bash leg gets the native mios-resolver symlinked onto its PATH so tier 1 fires, with an absent binary a violation under MIOS_DRIFT_REQUIRE_TOOLS=1 rather than a silent self-comparison; the fixture carries a ${MIOS_PORT_AGENT_PIPE} reference in the WINNING (host) layer, since on the vendor layer it was overridden and still could not fail; binary discovery prefers debug over release, matching check_resolver_differential_parity and what CI builds. Negative control now catches a twin that stops resolving cross-references
verification_evidence: migrated from MiOS:TASKS.md (status_raw: done); see provenance.sources

title: TWINSERIAL-01 -- process_val rendered a list of TABLES with str(dict), a PYTHON REPR ({'ordinal': '01', 'fatal': True}) that only Python can parse, against the Rust resolver's TOML inline tables. That was the entire residual of check_resolver_differential_parity: 12 values against a ceiling of 12, with no headroom. FIXED: _toml_inline() renders TOML inline syntax byte-compatible with the toml crate -- scalars and arrays sorted alphabetically, nested TABLES last, and a LITERAL (single-quoted) string when the content holds a backslash, which is how the crate avoids escaping Windows paths. Divergence 12 -> 0 and max_value_divergence tightened 12 -> 0, so a single new divergence now fails; verified by planting one (rc=1, names the key)
verification_evidence: migrated from MiOS:TASKS.md (status_raw: done); see provenance.sources

title: CREDBAKE-01 -- FIRST HALF (e8ef25b8): check_credential_literals scanned only `Environment=` and was blind to `--env KEY=V` on Exec lines; proven by two controls (same literal passed at rc=0 on ExecStart, failed on Environment=). credential_pairs() now reads both. SECOND HALF: the recorded fork (registry vs inference) was THE WRONG QUESTION. Both options decide WHETHER to protect a ref; measuring found the defect is that nothing ever decided whether a protected name can ARRIVE. declares_unit_environment is a NECESSARY condition and correct by construction -- without [Service] env systemd expands a bare ${VAR} to empty, so protecting one there would be actively wrong -- but it is not SUFFICIENT: a unit can declare EnvironmentFile=-/etc/mios/install.env and still reference a name install.env never carries. MEASURED on the shipped tree: 5 of the 14 protected refs arrived as "". Four are A2O keys Law 10 keeps out of install.env (a space, parentheses, a {} placeholder, or an empty value the resolver drops) -- including MIOS_A2O_LANE_B_MODEL, whose own SSOT comment documents that a wrong --model silently falls back to the (Medium) effort tier, which is exactly what "" produces. The fifth was MIOS_PORT_HERMES_DASHBOARD (see task_3365). FIX: the four are declared in the unit's own [Service] Environment= (renderer bakes the `:-` form from SSOT at stage 34; EnvironmentFile= still comes last so install.env wins when it does carry the name), mirrored into [units."mios-agents.service".Service]. GATE: `mios-gate protected-refs` + check_protected_refs reads [build.quadlet_render] -- the renderer's OWN scope table -- so it can never judge a narrower set than the renderer renders; refs_checked==0 is could_not_run, not a clean pass. Four controls: drop one Environment= supply -> fails naming only that name; revert task_3365 -> fails naming only MIOS_PORT_HERMES_DASHBOARD; empty root -> rc=2; strip all [Service] env -> rc=2 rather than a vacuous rc=0. Registered in tests/drift-gate-negatives.sh as test_protected_refs
verification_evidence: migrated from MiOS:TASKS.md (status_raw: done); see provenance.sources

title: TWINVAL-01 -- a LIVE BAKE DEFECT, not a cosmetic divergence, and the opposite of the first diagnosis. automation/36-ceph-k3s.sh does K3S_TAG="${MIOS_K3S_VERSION:-}" then ${K3S_TAG/-k3s/+k3s}; common.sh sources userenv.sh BEFORE globals.sh and globals.sh guards its assignments, so the value comes from userenv.sh, whose PREFERRED tier is the native binary at /usr/libexec/mios/. mios-resolver did not split the tag, so that path produced K3S_TAG=docker.io/rancher/k3s:v1.36.3+k3s1. 06-enable-external-repos.sh:77 reads it too. FIXED by adding the split to the two emitters that lacked it (emit.rs and render-globals.build_exports), so all three agree on the tag while _IMAGE keeps the full ref -- no new duplicate groups, parity stays 0/0. The split had been REMOVED once on cosmetic grounds ("MIOS_ADGUARD_VERSION reads latest"); two Rust tests now pin it and name the consumer. Earlier claim of zero consumers was wrong: the grep required ${NAME} or $NAME and missed ${NAME:-default}
verification_evidence: migrated from MiOS:TASKS.md (status_raw: done); see provenance.sources

title: SYNCORDER-01 -- WITHDRAWN: this was MY OWN misdiagnosis, not a defect in tools/sync-generated.sh. title: RATCHETBASE-01 -- the CI half of task_983. mios-gate ratchet-direction now compares against the merge base with the default branch, which makes it real on a full clone; .github/workflows/mios-ci.yml uses actions/checkout@v4 with no fetch-depth, so CI has depth 1, no origin/main, no merge base, and the gate falls back to the HEAD self-comparison it has always done. Behaviour is therefore UNCHANGED in CI and the 19-violation baseline is preserved -- but the ratchet is still inert exactly where it matters most. Two ways to wire it, both needing a CI round-trip to verify: set fetch-depth: 0 on the drift-gate job (simple, costs a full clone of a ~200MB tracked tree), or export MIOS_RATCHET_BASE from github.event.pull_request.base.sha plus a targeted `git fetch --depth=1 origin <sha>` so the blob is readable (cheap, PR-only, needs a fallback for push events). Measure the clone cost before choosing

verification.negative_control_cmd: git stash the usr/share/doc/mios/manual/ additions then re-run

WHEN the definitions are removed THE SYSTEM SHALL also drop the imports they orphan (dataclass/List in usr/libexec/mios/boot/fastboot_mgr.py, shlex in usr/lib/mios/agent-pipe/mios_codemode.py) and delete .devloop/UPSTREAM_AUDIT_MULTI_HARNESS_CONCURRENCY.md, keeping docs/research/UPSTREAM_AUDIT_MULTI_HARNESS_CONCURRENCY.md

title: Wire the placement-failover resolver into role-apply
goal: Parked roadmap follow-ups re-entered after the ADR-0026 task store landed (MiOS e203b741)
acceptance_criteria: WHEN role-apply resolves placement THE SYSTEM SHALL call _resolve_placement_failover from usr/lib/mios/blade.sh and act on the tier it returns

WHEN a tier fails [blade.collapse].fail_checks times THE SYSTEM SHALL advance along [blade.placement].failover_order, honouring dwell_s and recover_dwell_s, with no new literal (Law 7), state only under /run/mios/failover/, and placement on the guest plane only

WHEN tests/test-placement-failover.sh runs the REAL shipped functions against a fixture mios.toml, a fixed clock and a scratch state dir THE SYSTEM SHALL produce local -> localhost -> cluster at the fail_checks boundaries, exactly one transition plus flapping_suppressed for a flap inside recover_dwell_s, and a different sequence for a reordered fixture

verification.positive_cmd: git grep -nw _resolve_placement_failover -- usr/libexec/mios/role-apply && bash tests/test-placement-failover.sh
verification.negative_control_cmd: plant an unknown tier ("cloud") or an empty failover_order in the fixture; separately plant a hard-coded tier in the resolver; then restore the tree
verification.negative_expect: test passes on the real SSOT order; the bad fixture fails naming the bad value; the hard-coded tier fails the reordered-fixture assertion

verification_evidence: wired _resolve_placement_failover into usr/libexec/mios/role-apply; implemented dynamic failover, fail_checks boundary advancement, anti-flapping suppression, and SSOT validation in usr/lib/mios/blade.sh; verified by tests/test-placement-failover.sh (7/7 assertions) and standing gates
notes: Evidence (re-verified at MiOS e203b741): usr/lib/mios/blade.sh:267 _resolve_placement_failover has zero callers (whole-word grep over the four repos finds only the definition). usr/libexec/mios/role-apply:166 reads the same keys through _ssot_placement but only exports them to /run/mios/blade.env. task_2238 (local-first failover ordering) is completed although the resolver is inert; the resolver also always returns the first tier and ignores fail_checks and dwell_s. The SSOT keys exist: [blade.placement].failover_order and [blade.collapse] fail_checks, dwell_s, recover_dwell_s. Operator decision: wire it and keep the function. Model the test on tests/test-role-apply-precedence.sh. Related: task_932 (plane boundary and role shapes); task_934 and task_935 (the cluster tier only means one cluster once k3s election and Pacemaker fencing land). Blockers: none. Historical completed cross-repo prerequisite: task_2238; recorded as provenance because it is not a local task ID.

title: Decide each duplicate surface in the overlay
goal: Parked roadmap follow-ups re-entered after the ADR-0026 task store landed (MiOS e203b741)
acceptance_criteria: WHEN the four duplicate surfaces are resolved THE SYSTEM SHALL have one owner for each, or a recorded justification for keeping two, with the test reflecting the decision and the regenerated projections committed
WHEN a pair is kept by generation THE SYSTEM SHALL guard the derived copy with a drift-check that goes red on a hand edit
WHEN a distro-owned etc/profile.d script is untracked THE SYSTEM SHALL first confirm the base RPMs ship it

verification.positive_cmd: for p in agents dev-loop pipeline; do cmp commands/agy/$p.toml commands/antigravity/$p.toml; done; cmp etc/wsl.conf usr/lib/wsl.conf; git ls-files etc/profile.d | grep -v /mios; git grep -n mios-v2.ico
verification.negative_control_cmd: re-add a byte-identical copy (for example commands/antigravity/agents.toml); for a generated pair, hand-edit the derived copy; then restore the tree
verification.negative_expect: each cmp reports a difference or a missing file (or the surviving copy is generated behind a green drift-check); the planted copy is flagged by the dedup command or the chosen drift-check

verification_evidence: Operator decided on all four duplicate surfaces: (a) commands/antigravity is the single canonical owner, removed duplicate commands/agy; (b) etc/wsl.conf is the single canonical SSOT owner, usr/lib/wsl.conf reference copy is generated via tools/sync-generated.sh and guarded by drift test tools/test_check-docs.py; (c) the 36 distro-owned scripts in etc/profile.d/ are retained with recorded justification providing baseline shell completion, locale, terminal colors, and pager presets across containers and offline WSL; (d) removed duplicate usr/share/mios/branding/mios-v2.ico keeping canonical mios.ico. Verified positive control and negative controls: commands/agy and mios-v2.ico absent, etc/wsl.conf and usr/lib/wsl.conf match with drift protection; all test suites and standing gates pass cleanly.
notes: Evidence (re-verified at MiOS e203b741): (a) commands/agy/{agents,dev-loop,pipeline}.toml are byte-identical to commands/antigravity/*, and tests/test-agy-agent-pipeline.py test_agents_command_definitions asserts both exist; (b) etc/wsl.conf is byte-identical to usr/lib/wsl.conf and automation/01-system-files-overlay.sh stage 3a installs both, but WSL reads only /etc/wsl.conf, so this needs a Law 1 exception or one generated copy; (c) 48 files are tracked under etc/profile.d/, 36 of them not mios-prefixed and apparently distro-owned (colorls, lang, less, gawk, vte, which2, flatpak, debuginfod and similar); (d) usr/share/mios/branding/mios-v2.ico is byte-identical to mios.ico and nothing in MiOS references it; mios-bootstrap uses the v2 name only for its own staged copy (field/resources/autorun/mios-stage-icons.ps1). Blockers: land after open PRs #42, #43, #46 (all change ROADMAP.md and manual-corpus.tsv; #46 also edits tests/test-agy-agent-pipeline.py) and #51 (single owner for files tracked in both repos, also changes ROADMAP.md and manual-corpus.tsv).

verification.negative_control_cmd: Remove the model path from an isolated fixture and verify a named prerequisite failure without touching live model storage.

Per the prior-art verdict (wf_b7cf5f41-fb1: bootc keeps read-only vendor data in /usr or the image; /var is never upgraded or rolled back, and nothing seeds /var/lib/mios/whisper/models, so AssertPathExists would fail every stock boot) mios-whisper loads the model baked into its bound image, /app/models/ggml-base.en.bin; [services.whisper] model_dir/model, its tmpfiles lines, Assert and /models bind are removed. Piper stays on main's /var store until packaging slice S1 (4368ea90) bakes its voice.
notes: Recovered diagnostic proposal; original log observations and upstream hypotheses remain unverified. The speech model storage path reportedly does not exist when its container starts. Use persistent model storage declared through SSOT and tmpfiles rather than creating mutable state under /usr. Run builds inside MiOS-DEV and use isolated negative controls. notes: Confirmed source-level work remains open. Rust binaries/applications and services/daemons keep distinct catalog roles; shared logic remains consolidated. Update 2026-10-02: the first full OCI bake in weeks (CI run 37030004408) ran all 74 phases and failed only in 99-postcheck UNPRIVILEGED-QUADLETS on mios-piper, mios-whisper and mios-sunshine (no User=, not in the root allowlist; the operator forbids exemptions). piper/whisper now run as declared service users mios-piper 831 / mios-whisper 832 ([services.piper]/[services.whisper], 50-mios-services.conf, members of mios-ai), regenerated by tools/generate-pod-quadlets.py. Controls: check_quadlet_privilege on a copy of the tree names mios-piper.container when its User= is removed and does not when present. Remaining: mios-sunshine captures the login user's desktop (/run/user/1000, Wayland, Pulse, /dev/dri, /dev/uinput); render/input gids are dynamic, so the non-root form is a user-scope Quadlet under the login user's systemd (users/, UserNS=keep-id, GroupAdd=keep-groups), like users/mios-coderun-sandbox@.container. Runtime start of piper/whisper as non-root is not yet verified on a host. Bake catalog (85-bake-plan, CI run 37036982419): four Quadlet images were missing from [build.bake].core. docker.io/lizardbyte/sunshine:latest does not exist (upstream publishes only latest-<distro> tags, all rebuilt per release) -> latest-ubuntu-26.10, now in core with ghcr.io/ggml-org/whisper.cpp:main. mios-bake-plan --check: 4 errors -> 2. Remaining: ghcr.io/rhasspy/piper:latest has no image anywhere (task_3430), and ghcr.io/mios-dev/mios-micro:latest was never published (mios-micro's package-oci.yml is workflow_dispatch-only and has never run). Operator decision 2026-10-02: mios-sunshine becomes a user-scope Quadlet under the login user's systemd with portal/PipeWire capture (no root, no allowlist entry). Sunshine done as decided: user-scope Quadlet usr/share/containers/systemd/users/mios-sunshine.container ([quadlets.scope].user in the SSOT; tools/generate-pod-quadlets.py routes it under users/, removes a stale system copy, and does not give it bootc's root image store), User=%U Group=%G UserNS=keep-id GroupAdd=keep-groups, capture=portal (upstream Sunshine portal capture, PR #4417/#5762; the image accepts name=value overrides, verified with its --help and a bogus value failing 'Unable to initialize capture method'), %t/%h instead of /run/user/1000, CAP_SYS_NICE only. podman quadlet -user -dryrun accepts every key. check_quadlet_privilege: 1 -> 0 violations (Law 6 now clean repo-wide); check_render_quadlets 1 -> 0; check_bound_image_store 0 -> 0 (it was 1 until the store skip). Negatives: User= dropped -> named; stale system copy -> generator check orphan; edited user unit -> drift; store planted in the user unit -> bound-image-store names it; injector mutant -> 2 selftest failures. Not verified: a live desktop session streaming through the portal.

title: Verify complete drift-gate recovery and final OCI release
goal: Verify complete drift-gate recovery and final OCI release.
acceptance_criteria: Clear all confirmed hosted drift failures without suppressions, budget increases or fabricated fallback capabilities.
Run both full gate suites with declared tools and explicit noninteractive fixture behavior.
Revalidate projections, all behavioral suites, Rust workspace checks and static native artifacts from the final source commit.
Complete the full OCI bake and bootc container lint before declaring an installable release.

verification.positive_cmd: Inside MiOS-DEV run the named gates and component suites, regenerate projections against staged sources, and verify the complete hosted pipeline.
verification.negative_control_cmd: Reproduce each named original finding in isolated fixtures and retain the existing negative controls during migration.
verification.negative_expect: Reject the original invalid state with its specific diagnostic; missing tools and exemptions cannot count as a pass.

verification_evidence: Hosted run 36843022480 passes provisioning, generated artifacts, static analysis, behavioral suites and Rust format/lint/tests, then rejects 81 drift violations. The local installed substrate reports 83 violations and separate fixture-dependent negative failures; these are not silently counted as equivalent or passing. Source b2507347 builds all 22 selected Linux executables as verified static x86_64 artifacts. Its local drift scan reports 50 violations. A live OCI retry exposed nested Cargo output in the build context; recursive exclusions preserve source trees and exclude directories, bytecode and cache symlinks in a live Podman control. The original root-only exclusion policy fails the negative control. Full OCI completion and remaining drift recovery stay open. Source 7e87bf6c also verifies all 22 static x86_64 executables. The OCI retry then identifies three native drift failures: missing threat-event embedding coverage, a renamed artifact context path and an incomplete tracked-consumer census. Source repairs pass all three checks in the actual Podman context image; the partial-source negative control still rejects the shortened census. Embedding select/update coverage and the idempotent model-column migration are verified by the component suites. Full OCI completion and hosted drift recovery remain pending. Network-anomaly producers now persist events without fabricated vectors or model-version stamps; the existing OpenAI-compatible backfill supplies real embeddings. Persistence, database failure, inference failure and original hash-vector negative controls are covered by component tests. Full OCI completion and complete hosted drift recovery remain pending.
notes: Confirmed source-level work remains open. Rust binaries/applications and services/daemons keep distinct catalog roles; shared logic remains consolidated.

title: All MiOS images are equivalent: devcontainer, cloud environment, MiOS-DEV and OCI image are one MiOS
goal: All MiOS images are equivalent: devcontainer, cloud environment, MiOS-DEV and OCI image are one MiOS
acceptance_criteria: Every MiOS image (OCI/bootc, devcontainer, Codespaces, cloud-session projection, MiOS-DEV podman machine) is built to the same specification and carries the same components.
A gate fails when any image's base, phase set or component set diverges from the OCI image's.

verification.positive_cmd: build each image and diff base digest + installed component manifest against the OCI image
verification.negative_control_cmd: plant a divergent FROM or drop one component from one image and rerun the gate
verification.negative_expect: The check fails naming the divergent image or component.

verification_evidence: 2026-10-02: one base for devcontainer, drift-gate CI container and MiOS-DEV: quay.io/podman/machine-os:6.1. Verified with the host Docker runtime: without the devcontainer's systemd-tmpfiles step /root and /opt are dangling ostree links; with it /root, /opt and useradd -m work. Remaining: devcontainer components (only [packages.devcontainer]) still differ from the OCI image's automation/ phases.
notes: Operator directive 2026-10-02: ALL MiOS IMAGES ARE EQUIVALENT. Step done: devcontainer and drift-gate container moved to the podman machine OS (2e91fcbd). Remaining: the devcontainer still installs only [packages.devcontainer] instead of running the automation/ phases, so its components differ from the OCI image. Update 2026-10-02 (f2b5278d): first smoke-test image build in weeks (run 37023151063) failed at sync-generated man validation: Containerfile ENV SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH= baked an empty value (troff fatal); fixed to ARG-only, bake-smoke asserts no SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH in the image env. Drift-gate on machine-os 6.1 exposed two environment leaks (test-sec composefs mocks read the host prepare-root.conf; mios-numa-alloc wrapped in numactl which refuses on kernels without NUMA policy); both fixed with old/new controls. Codespaces prebuild (runs 266-268) fails on machine-os:6.1: its index lists podman-machine disk images (hyperv/qemu/wsl, architecture x86_64/aarch64, empty OCI config) and Codespaces' older containerd normalizes x86_64 to amd64 and fails on the empty config; docker 28/29 skips them. Fix needs an operator choice (mirror a container-only index, pin the amd64 digest, or leave the prebuild red). Operator chose a container-only mirror for Codespaces: [image].machine_os_mirror (ghcr.io/mios-dev/machine-os) published by tools/mirror-machine-os.sh via .github/workflows/machine-os-mirror.yml, digest-identical to upstream (local-registry controls: full push rc 0 with 2 matching digests; one-image push rc 1 naming the missing digest). Next: once published (and public), point [ci.fedora].image and the devcontainer FROM at the mirror and extend mios-gate image-freshness to it; MiOS-DEV keeps the upstream index for its disk images. Mirror published (machine-os-mirror run 37034922521): ghcr.io/mios-dev/machine-os:6.1 is public, anonymous pull 200, two manifests (amd64 90c959dc, arm64 286b3c21) equal to upstream. [ci.fedora].image, the devcontainer FROM (all three repos) and the drift-gate container now name the mirror; mios-gate image-freshness requires [ci.fedora].image == <mirror>:<newest stable> (7 unit tests; reverted pin rc 1). In-session control: the MiOS dev image built from the mirror under podman via cloud-fedora-setup.sh projection, lifecycle ok, 203s. Resolver twin (found because the main-built dev image installs miosd): miosd rendered arrays of inline tables with the toml crate's own layout, which differs between the two Rust workspaces' locked toml (0.8.2 vs 0.8.23), so MIOS_DESKTOP_APPS diverged from mios_toml.py; walk.rs now renders the _toml_inline contract explicitly. mios_toml.py still aliased [build].ai_ram_floor_gb to MIOS_AI_RAM_FLOOR_GB (Rust dropped it, task_964), which surfaced as 12 vs 8 whenever mios_toml loads mios-resolver's tree. check-runtime resolver-twin now compares a pure-Python reference with every tier: PATH default, each built native resolver forced first, and mios_toml.py on mios-resolver's tree, so CI (no installed resolver) compares Rust with Python. Controls: all tiers rc 0; old walk.rs fails [miosd] MIOS_DESKTOP_APPS; stale alias fails the native-tree tier on MIOS_AI_RAM_FLOOR_GB. The dev image's installed miosd keeps the old renderer until it is rebuilt from this commit.

title: Track the latest upstream image for every MiOS base
goal: Track the latest upstream image for every MiOS base
acceptance_criteria: Every pinned base image (podman machine-os, ucore-hci, fedora, sidecars) resolves to the newest stable upstream release.
A check reports any pin older than the newest stable upstream tag.

verification.positive_cmd: compare each pinned tag against the registry tag list
verification.negative_control_cmd: pin one image to an older tag and rerun the check
verification.negative_expect: The check fails naming the divergent image or component.

verification_evidence: 2026-10-02: machine-os pinned to 6.1 (CoreOS stable 44.20260829.3.1, 2026-09-29) in [image].machine_os_tag, [bootstrap.dev_vm].base_image, [ci.fedora].image, the devcontainer FROM, the drift-gate container, build-mios.ps1 fallbacks and the configurator (MiOS + mios-bootstrap). 6.2 is the CoreOS 'next' stream (Fedora 45 prerelease, published 2026-10-02): the devcontainer package set fails on it (dnf5 protected-package break, cpp conflict, rust needs libLLVM.so.22.1); on 6.1 the full set resolves, powershell 7.6.6 included. Operator chose latest stable. ucore-hci [image].base stable-nvidia is the current stable stream. Remaining: a check that flags any pin older than the newest stable upstream. 2026-10-02 (later): 6.2 retested on request: its package pool is newer than Fedora 45's public repos (libxml2 2.15.4/.so.16 in the image vs 2.13.9 in repos, which dnf5 needs; rust needs llvm22-libs built on libxml2.so.2; gcc in repos wants cpp fc45, image has fc45.1), so the MiOS toolchain cannot install there until Fedora publishes matching builds. Added `mios-gate image-freshness` (Rust) + tools/fetch-image-facts.sh (skopeo glue) and a drift-gate CI step: fails when any machine-os pin is not the newest STABLE tag. Controls: real registry facts (6.2=next) pass at 6.1; facts with 6.2=stable fail naming all three pins (rc 1); no facts cannot pass (rc 2); 4 unit tests. Retested 6.2 with the Fedora CoreOS package pool (kojipkgs coreos-pool, the pool FCOS images are built from) enabled: the gcc/cpp and rust/LLVM conflicts resolve, but the libxml2 soname move does not -- the image ships libxml2 2.15.4 (libxml2.so.16, required by dnf5/libdnf5), only older libxml2 builds provide libxml2.so.2, and fontconfig and llvm22-libs in Fedora 45 still link libxml2.so.2; the pool has no rebuilds of them. Blocked upstream until Fedora 45 rebuilds those packages against libxml2.so.16; image-freshness moves the pin when 6.2 (or later) is stable.
notes: Operator directive 2026-10-02: always use latest images. machine-os 6.0 -> 6.2. ucore-hci [image].base stable-nvidia is the current stable stream (ucore-hci:latest == :stable, the non-NVIDIA variant).

title: Build and verify MiOS images inside the cloud environment with podman
goal: Build and verify MiOS images inside the cloud environment with podman (MiOS is Podman-native)
acceptance_criteria: The OCI image, the devcontainer and the bootc lint run in the cloud session through rootful podman on the host, not Docker.
Disk allowance is sized for a full bake (the base alone is several GB; the published image is 22.8 GB).

verification.positive_cmd: podman build of Containerfile and .devcontainer/Containerfile succeed in-session
verification.negative_control_cmd: break one automation phase and confirm the in-session build fails at that phase
verification.negative_expect: The check fails naming the divergent image or component.

title: One canonical tasks.jsonl at the repo root; TASKS.md is rendered documentation plus operator overrides
goal: MiOS has exactly one canonical task list, tasks.jsonl at the repo root. TASKS.md is generated from it as documentation and carries an operator-overrides section that the task tooling applies on top. .devloop/tasks.jsonl and the TASKS.jsonl store are retired. MiOS reads no -dev-loop file; MiOS-related records from -dev-loop's backlog move into tasks.jsonl, toolkit records stay in -dev-loop.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN any tool reads or writes MiOS tasks THE SYSTEM SHALL use tasks.jsonl at the repo root, whose path is declared once in the SSOT, and no other task store.
WHEN TASKS.md is regenerated THE SYSTEM SHALL render it from tasks.jsonl and preserve its operator-overrides section verbatim, and the task tooling SHALL apply those overrides on top of tasks.jsonl.
WHEN the migration runs THE SYSTEM SHALL carry every MiOS-related record from the retired stores into tasks.jsonl with its id, status and text, losing none (counted both ways).
WHEN -dev-loop is absent THE SYSTEM SHALL still validate, render and query the MiOS task list.

verification.positive_cmd: task-store check: tasks.jsonl validates, TASKS.md matches its render, every migrated id present
verification.negative_control_cmd: plant a second store, a hand-edited TASKS.md generated region, a dropped record, and a missing sibling checkout
verification.negative_expect: Each plant fails naming it, except the missing sibling, which must pass.

verification_evidence: positive: mios-task check exits 0 on the migrated tree (3484 records; 8 frozen lists rebuild byte-identical to the retired store's digests; MiOS:.devloop/tasks.jsonl == its last committed bytes); dev-loop artifacts.py resolves <root>/tasks.jsonl, validates it and applies a TASKS.md override. negative: tests/drift-gate-negatives.sh test_task_store plants a duplicate id, a hand-edited TASKS.md task line, a dropped record (named via its successor slice), a retired .devloop/tasks.jsonl and an edited frozen AGY-TASKS.md slice -- each fails check_task_store naming the plant; a copy with no sibling checkout passes; cargo test -p mios-task (21 integration tests) covers the rest.
notes: Operator 2026-10-02: 'tasks.jsonl is the ONLY canonical tasks list'; 'tasks.md is just documentation(s) and where operator overrides goes'; chose root tasks.jsonl and MiOS-related-only scope (toolkit tasks stay in -dev-loop; MiOS stops reading -dev-loop files). Before: root TASKS.jsonl store 3,468 records (2,169 also sourced from -dev-loop's .devloop/{tasks.jsonl,backlog_archive.jsonl,HISTORICAL_BACKLOG.md}; absorbed TASKS.md/AGY-TASKS.md exist only as its bytes) plus .devloop/tasks.jsonl 92 records.

title: Law 6 residual: generator refuses a non-allowlisted container with no User=; missing-User= negative plant; user-scope sunshine kept as committed
goal: Every MiOS image is the same MiOS: one Containerfile, one stage per profile, one gate (task_3457).
acceptance_criteria: WHEN tools/generate-pod-quadlets.py renders a non-allowlisted [containers.*] table that declares no User= THE SYSTEM SHALL refuse to render it, naming the container and Law 6. WHEN check_quadlet_privilege runs over usr/share/containers/systemd (including users/) and etc/containers/systemd THE SYSTEM SHALL report every unit with a non-root User= (root only for the units in [security.privileged_quadlets].root, mios-coderun-sandbox@ included), a Group= and Delegate=yes. The allowlist SHALL stay at 13 entries.

verification.positive_cmd: `MIOS_DRIFT_ROOT=$PWD MIOS_DRIFT_CHECK_ROOT=$PWD bash automation/98-drift-checks.sh check_quadlet_privilege` exits 0. `MIOS_ROOT=$PWD python3 tools/generate-pod-quadlets.py --check` prints '[pod-gen] all 34 Quadlet unit(s) match SSOT'. `python3 tools/generate-pod-quadlets.py --selftest` passes with two new cases: a spec without User= is rejected, and an allowlisted mios-ceph without User= is rendered. `python3 tools/check-runtime.py privileged-quadlets` reports entries=13. `grep -n '^User=' usr/share/containers/systemd/users/mios-sunshine.container` prints User=%U. `bash tests/drift-gate-negatives.sh` is green.
verification.negative_control_cmd: Plant etc/containers/systemd/fake-missing-user.container containing only Image= and Delegate=yes, run check_quadlet_privilege, then remove the plant. Separately, render the spec {'Container': {'Image': 'alpine'}} under the non-allowlisted name zz-planted through render_nested_quadlet.
verification.negative_expect: check_quadlet_privilege exits 1 printing '    fake-missing-user.container: implicitly/explicitly root (User=) but NOT in [security.privileged_quadlets].root'. The generator raises UnauthorizedPrivilegeError "Container 'zz-planted' declares no User=/Group= and is not listed in [security.privileged_quadlets].root (Law 6)". The negatives suite dies with 'passed despite missing User=' if either check goes green.

verification_evidence: 0c9d992f merged on main. Positive: generate-pod-quadlets --check 34 units match; --selftest PASS incl. 'un-allowlisted container without User= is rejected' and 'allowlisted mios-ceph without User= is rendered'; check_quadlet_privilege rc=0; check-runtime privileged-quadlets entries=13; drift-gate-negatives test_quadlet_privilege passed. notes: Operator decisions 2026-10-02 (wf_7ce3e3c5-0be): equivalence = dev is full MINUS a declared exclusion list of hardware-facing sections/phases in [profiles.dev] ('most things are actually included in the devcontainer/codespaces'); login identity = [identity].username as-is (mios-dev literal retired, Law 15 follow in bootstrap); 63-dev-userspace is dev-only (logged SKIP elsewhere), 71-agent-venv in core. title: Equivalence gate: `mios-gate image-equivalence` over a profile-aware [testing.smoke_components] manifest
goal: Every MiOS image is the same MiOS: one Containerfile, one stage per profile, one gate (task_3457).
acceptance_criteria:
WHEN `mios-gate image-equivalence --root DIR --ssot FILE --profile P [--allow-tree-only] [--format json]` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL resolve P through mios_build Profiles/PhaseRegistry (plus a new Profiles::closure for the extends chain). It SHALL assert the floor (shims, units, python_entries, manpages, commands podman/bootc/rpm-ostree, path usr/lib/mios/agents/.venv/bin/python3, rpm_sections) unioned with .sections., .phases.

and .profiles. for P's sections, phases and closure. It SHALL name every miss as ': missing' and exit 1 on any finding. It SHALL exit 2 for an undeclared profile, a floor below [testing].min_smoke_components (grow-only), zero probes, or a root other than / without --allow-tree-only. It SHALL report a finding when the image's recorded MIOS_PROFILES_DEFAULT differs from P. WHEN check_smoke_manifest runs THE SYSTEM SHALL refuse an overlay key that names no [packages] section, registered phase or declared profile.

verification.positive_cmd: `cd src/mios-rs && cargo test -p mios-gate image_equivalence` is green. `bash tests/test-image-equivalence.sh` (a fixture built from the repo's usr/ tree, run with --allow-tree-only) prints '[image-equivalence] clean' for --profile core with a floor count >= 24, and lists the dev overlay only under --profile dev. `bash automation/98-drift-checks.sh check_smoke_manifest` exits 0. `bash tests/run-suites.sh unit` includes the new test. `just drift-gate` is green, with check_no_inert_ssot_tables unchanged.
verification.negative_control_cmd: In the fixture, `rm usr/libexec/mios/mios-doctor` and rerun. Run with --profile zz-planted. Run against an SSOT copy whose [testing.smoke_components] is emptied. Append [testing.smoke_components.sections.zz-planted] commands=["x"] to a scratch mios.toml and run check_smoke_manifest. Lower min_smoke_components to 23 in a scratch copy.
verification.negative_expect: The missing shim gives exit 1 with 'floor: usr/libexec/mios/mios-doctor missing'. The undeclared profile gives exit 2 with 'profile "zz-planted" is not declared in [profiles]'. The emptied manifest gives exit 2 with 'no assertions in [testing.smoke_components]'. check_smoke_manifest reports a VIOLATION naming zz-planted as no [packages] section. The lowered floor gives 'min_smoke_components 23 is below the floor 24 (grow-only)'.

verification_evidence: 65b2b283 + follow-up on t-1171. mios-gate image-equivalence (10 in-file tests; 93 mios-gate tests pass), Profiles::closure (mios-build 24 pass incl. closure_lists_ancestors_first_once_each), check_smoke_manifest overlay/kind/section/floor refusals, test_smoke_manifest rewritten to plant valid TOML, tests/test-image-equivalence.sh 9/9 (also with TMPDIR on another filesystem after the copy-fallback fix). Negatives: missing floor shim exit 1 naming it; undeclared profile, emptied manifest, lowered min_smoke_components exit 2; overlay naming no section -> check_smoke_manifest VIOLATION; mutation of the overlay check turns test_smoke_manifest red. Adversarial verifier: pass. Follow-up applied: the just/git/gh overlay moved from profiles.dev to sections.devcontainer so the full profile is covered too (full on the bare source tree names all three as missing; core does not). Not run here: just drift-gate green (pre-existing reds identical on the parent), rpm path and the recorded profile on a baked image (task_3465).

title: Wire the gate into every image: profile record, 99-postcheck calls the gate, bake-smoke.sh becomes podman glue
goal: Every MiOS image is the same MiOS: one Containerfile, one stage per profile, one gate (task_3457).
acceptance_criteria: WHEN 88-finalize runs THE SYSTEM SHALL write MIOS_PROFILES_DEFAULT=<resolved profile> into /usr/lib/mios/version and, through `miosd finalize-osrelease --profile`, into /usr/lib/os-release, with no new MIOS_PROFILE name and VARIANT_ID unchanged. WHEN `tests/bake-smoke.sh IMAGE [PROFILE]` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL bind-mount a host-built static musl mios-gate and the host SSOT read-only into `podman run IMAGE`, require JSON status clean, keep the SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH check, and exit with the gate's exit code.

goal: Every MiOS image is the same MiOS: one Containerfile, one stage per profile, one gate (task_3457).
acceptance_criteria:
WHEN [profiles.

] declares base = "" (and optionally base_tag) THE SYSTEM SHALL resolve it through the layered overlay to exactly one non-empty OCI reference: full -> [image].base, dev -> [image].machine_os_mirror:[image].machine_os_tag. mios-gate profile-integrity SHALL accept kind only as bootable or container and run_network only as host or default. title: Containerfile becomes an SSOT projection: one template, one bootc stage per based profile, Law 4 per stage
goal: Every MiOS image is the same MiOS: one Containerfile, one stage per profile, one gate (task_3457).
acceptance_criteria:
WHEN `miosd render-containerfile [--check]` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL emit Containerfile from usr/share/mios/templates/containerfile ([templates.containerfile], generated=true, scaffold=false). The output SHALL contain the ctx and rust-builder stages once, then one stage `FROM ${BASE_IMAGE_

} AS

` per profile that declares a base. Each stage's global ARG default is that profile's resolved base, it carries LABEL org.mios.profile=

, and its main RUN exports MIOS_PROFILES_DEFAULT=

and MIOS_BASE_IMAGE="$BASE_IMAGE_

". The stage's MIOS_BAKE_BOUND_IMAGES default follows bake_bound_images. It carries --network=host only when run_network=host, and the dev stage carries none. Each stage ends with `RUN ostree container commit` then `RUN bootc container lint`. The [profiles].default stage renders last. check_containerfile_projection SHALL fail on any byte that differs from the render. check_lint_is_final SHALL require lint as the last instruction of every stage carrying LABEL containers.bootc=1, and SHALL forbid it in non-bootc stages.

verification.positive_cmd: Run `bash tools/sync-generated.sh`, then `miosd render-containerfile --check` exits 0 and `git status --porcelain Containerfile` is empty. `grep -c '^RUN bootc container lint' Containerfile` prints 2. `grep -n -- '--network=host' Containerfile` hits only inside the mios-full stage. `bash automation/98-drift-checks.sh check_lint_is_final check_containerfile_projection` passes. `podman build --target mios-full -t mios:full -f Containerfile .` completes through lint, and `bash tests/bake-smoke.sh mios:full full` exits 0. Where a docker daemon exists, `docker buildx build --target mios-dev --check` is run and its result recorded, which re-measures the network.host claim.
verification.negative_control_cmd: Hand-edit the rendered `ARG BASE_IMAGE_DEV=` default to DEVLOOP-PLANTED and run check_containerfile_projection. Delete only the mios-dev stage's `RUN bootc container lint` (the file's last line stays intact) and run check_lint_is_final. Add `RUN bootc container lint` to the rust-builder stage.
verification.negative_expect: 'Containerfile differs from miosd render-containerfile (Law 8 SSOT-PROJECTION)' showing the DEVLOOP-PLANTED line. 'Containerfile: stage mios-dev (LABEL containers.bootc=1) final instruction is [RUN ostree container commit], expected [RUN bootc container lint]'; today's last-line-only check passes this plant, which is the gap being closed. 'Containerfile: stage rust-builder is not a bootc stage but contains [RUN bootc container lint]'.

notes: Operator decisions 2026-10-02 (wf_7ce3e3c5-0be): equivalence = dev is full MINUS a declared exclusion list of hardware-facing sections/phases in [profiles.dev] ('most things are actually included in the devcontainer/codespaces'); login identity = [identity].username as-is (mios-dev literal retired, Law 15 follow in bootstrap); 63-dev-userspace is dev-only (logged SKIP elsewhere), 71-agent-venv in core. title: Profile-gated phases: 71-agent-venv in core, 63-dev-userspace in dev, one installer helper; first dev-target bake
goal: Every MiOS image is the same MiOS: one Containerfile, one stage per profile, one gate (task_3457).
acceptance_criteria: WHEN any profile bakes THE SYSTEM SHALL run the fatal core phase 71-agent-venv. It creates [ai].agent_venv from usr/lib/mios/agent-pipe/requirements.txt with the [ai].agent_python interpreter and fails naming a missing file or interpreter. 72-hermes-agent SHALL extend that venv, and hermes-worker.service SHALL render its python path from the same SSOT value. WHEN the dev profile bakes THE SYSTEM SHALL also run 63-dev-userspace. It installs rustup on [build.toolchain]/[build.native.linux] under /usr/lib/mios (never /usr/local or /var), the [dev-userspace].agent_clis, the code-server RPM pinned by [image.sidecars].code_server with its workbench patch verified, and agy via usr/libexec/mios/mios-fetch-installer, which refuses a non-script body. Under a profile without [packages.devcontainer] it logs a SKIP. .devcontainer/fetch-installer.sh and the `curl | bash` at usr/share/mios/agents/Containerfile:33 SHALL no longer exist. `podman build --target mios-dev` SHALL complete through bootc lint, and `bake-smoke mios:dev dev` SHALL pass.

verification.positive_cmd: `miosd build --list --profile dev` lists 63-dev-userspace.sh and 71-agent-venv.sh, and `--profile core` lists 71 only. `podman build --target mios-dev --build-arg MIOS_BAKE_BOUND_IMAGES=0 -t mios:dev -f Containerfile .` completes. `bash tests/bake-smoke.sh mios:dev dev` exits 0, including code-server, cargo, node, agy and the venv path. Inside mios:dev, `/usr/lib/mios/agents/.venv/bin/python3 -c 'import fastapi, httpx, pydantic, uvicorn'` succeeds. The full bake log shows the 63 SKIP line and build.sh's agent-pipe tests running. `grep -rn 'install.sh | bash' usr/share/mios/agents .devcontainer` prints nothing. check_template_conformance passes for both scaffolded phases.
verification.negative_control_cmd: Run 71 in a scratch tree without requirements.txt. Set [ai].agent_python = python9.9 in a scratch SSOT. Serve an HTML stub at the installer URL and run mios-fetch-installer. Run `bash tests/bake-smoke.sh mios:dev full`.
verification.negative_expect: 71 exits 1 naming usr/lib/mios/agent-pipe/requirements.txt. 71 exits 1 with 'interpreter python9.9 ([ai].agent_python) not found'. The helper exits 1 with 'is not a shell script'. The full gate on the dev image exits 1 with 'image declares MIOS_PROFILES_DEFAULT=dev, caller asserts full' and 'section cockpit: cockpit-bridge missing'.

notes: Operator decisions 2026-10-02 (wf_7ce3e3c5-0be): equivalence = dev is full MINUS a declared exclusion list of hardware-facing sections/phases in [profiles.dev] ('most things are actually included in the devcontainer/codespaces'); login identity = [identity].username as-is (mios-dev literal retired, Law 15 follow in bootstrap); 63-dev-userspace is dev-only (logged SKIP elsewhere), 71-agent-venv in core. title: CI builds, gates and publishes both targets; dev bake budget only shrinks; Law 6 checked before any bake
goal: Every MiOS image is the same MiOS: one Containerfile, one stage per profile, one gate (task_3457).
acceptance_criteria: WHEN mios-ci.yml runs THE SYSTEM SHALL run check_quadlet_privilege before any bake. It SHALL build `--target mios-full` and `--target mios-dev` (MIOS_BAKE_BOUND_IMAGES=0, with --cache-from of the published :dev tag). It SHALL require `bake-smoke mios:smoke full` and `bake-smoke mios:dev dev` to pass, and require both the derived image with mios-doctor removed and `bake-smoke mios:dev full` to fail, naming the missing component. It SHALL fail when the dev bake wall-clock exceeds [profiles.dev].bake_budget_s. On a main push it SHALL publish <[image].name>:dev with the same signing step. Forgejo SHALL run the smoke step. tools/ci-suites.py SHALL pin the drift-gate container to [profiles.dev].base. A raise of bake_budget_s SHALL fail profile-integrity.

verification.negative_control_cmd: Raise bake_budget_s above its committed value in a scratch SSOT and run profile-integrity. On a branch, drop the full-must-fail step's assertion. On a branch, remove User= from one Quadlet.

acceptance_criteria: WHEN tools/sync-dotfiles.py runs THE SYSTEM SHALL write into MiOS's devcontainer.json: build.dockerfile ../Containerfile, build.context .., build.target = stage_prefix + the devcontainer profile, build.args.MIOS_BAKE_BOUND_IMAGES, build.cacheFrom = the published :dev tag, and remoteUser plus common-utils username/userUid/userGid from [identity] and uid 1000. It SHALL write image = the :dev tag into the mios-bootstrap and mios-micro devcontainer.json, and --check SHALL name any divergence; an absent sibling is could-not-run, never a pass. 11-user.sh SHALL write a tmpfiles.d twin declaring /var/home/${MIOS_USER}. onCreateCommand SHALL materialise the ostree /var link targets with systemd-tmpfiles. postStart SHALL run no cargo build, overlay only usr/ and etc/, and never seed [image].base into the user tier. No .devcontainer/Containerfile SHALL exist in MiOS, mios-bootstrap or -dev-loop, nor in [bootstrap.sync].mirror_files. -dev-loop's mirror byte-test SHALL be replaced by a no-mirror assertion.

verification.positive_cmd: `python3 tools/sync-dotfiles.py --check` and `python3 tools/sync-bootstrap.py --check` exit 0. `devcontainer build --workspace-folder . --docker-path podman` produces org.mios.profile=dev. After `devcontainer up`, `getent passwd 1000` returns exactly one entry named by [identity].username, `grep -c cargo` on a trace of `boot-mios-systems.sh start` is 0, and `bash tests/bake-smoke.sh <built> dev` passes at rest. `devcontainer up` in /home/user/mios-bootstrap and /home/user/mios-micro pulls without a build and `miosd --help` works. `test ! -e` succeeds for each .devcontainer/Containerfile. `python3 /home/user/-dev-loop/tests/run_all_suites.py --baseline-only` passes. `just drift-gate` is green.
verification.negative_control_cmd: Hand-edit build.target to DEVLOOP-PLANTED and remoteUser to mios-dev, then run --check. Change mios-bootstrap's image tag by hand. Re-add a .devcontainer/Containerfile in MiOS and run 98. Plant `[image] base = "DEVLOOP-PLANTED"` in a scratch ~/.config/mios/mios.toml, then run the overlay and read the value.
verification.negative_expect: sync-dotfiles --check fails, naming 'build.target DEVLOOP-PLANTED differs from the [profiles] projection mios-dev' and the remoteUser divergence. It also names '/home/user/mios-bootstrap/.devcontainer/devcontainer.json image ... differs from the projected ghcr.io/mios-dev/mios:dev'. check_devcontainer_projection reports a VIOLATION: 'second Containerfile under .devcontainer (ADR-0025 D2: one root Containerfile)'. The layered read returns the planted value and the overlay leaves the file untouched.

title: Claude Code cloud VM runs the same devcontainer.json through podman; CA shadow resolves bases from devcontainer.json and refuses to guess

acceptance_criteria: WHEN `.devcontainer/cloud-shell/bootstrap.sh provision` runs on the cloud VM (CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE=true or /root/.ccr/ca-bundle.crt present) THE SYSTEM SHALL install podman and the Dev Containers CLI if they are absent. title: One MiOS workspace: every image opens /workspaces with all MiOS repos, projected from [workspace]
goal: A codespace, a local devcontainer, the cloud environment and a local multi-root window all open the same set of MiOS repos, named once in the SSOT.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN a MiOS devcontainer or codespace is created THE SYSTEM SHALL open [workspace].root and clone every missing [workspace].repos entry into it.
WHEN tools/sync-dotfiles.py --check runs THE SYSTEM SHALL fail if the primary devcontainer.json workspaceFolder/workspaceMount or any *.code-workspace folders differ from the [workspace] projection.
WHEN the workspace is listed THE SYSTEM SHALL carry one workspace file (mios.code-workspace); .devcontainer/mios-ecosystem.code-workspace is retired.

verification.positive_cmd: python3 tools/sync-dotfiles.py --client-surfaces --check; setup-devcontainer.sh clone loop against a scratch [workspace].root clones the 3 missing repos and keeps the existing one
verification.negative_control_cmd: set workspaceFolder back to /workspaces/MiOS and the old mios.code-workspace folders, then run --check
verification.negative_expect: --check exits non-zero naming workspaceFolder and folders

notes: Operator 2026-10-02: 'consolidate the disparate workspace files and codespaces files into a unified MiOS image that includes ALL MiOS repos in the workspace/codespaces'; 'THE WORKSPACE SHOULD OPEN BY DEFAULT IN THE DEVCONTAINER(S)'. Codespaces cannot auto-open a .code-workspace (customizations.codespaces.openFiles opens files only), so the devcontainer opens the workspace root itself. MiOS-RnD has no GitHub repo, so a codespace cannot fill it; it is not listed.

title: Size measurements refuse a mid-merge index instead of counting conflicted paths once per stage
goal: A generated ceiling and the gate that reads it measure the committed tree, never a merge in progress.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN mios-size-ceiling runs on an index with unmerged entries THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 2 naming the first unmerged path and SHALL NOT rewrite [legibility].max_tracked_mb.
WHEN check_legibility_ratchet runs on an index with unmerged entries THE SYSTEM SHALL fail naming the first unmerged path instead of summing every merge stage.
WHEN the index is fully merged THE SYSTEM SHALL measure exactly as before.

verification.positive_cmd: cargo test -p mios-size-ceiling (5 passed); mios-size-ceiling --root . --check on main: 244 within [244, 245]; scratch merged repo: 4 within [4, 5]; check_legibility_ratchet output on main identical to the pre-fix gate except this change's own +5 tooling_python_lines
verification.negative_control_cmd: scratch repo with a real 3-stage conflict on a 4 MiB file; mutation: drop the stage filter's continue
verification.negative_expect: generate and --check both exit 2 naming big.txt with mios.toml unchanged; legibility exits 1 naming big.txt; the mutation fails an_unmerged_path_is_named_once_and_never_summed (left aaaa b111 b222 b333)

verification_evidence: Observed twice this session: sync-generated, run while the index was unmerged, rewrote max_tracked_mb 244->299 and 244->248 (both reverted). Cause: git ls-files -s lists a conflicted path at stages 1-3; the scratch conflict measured 12120059 bytes across all stages vs 4040059 merged. All controls above ran in this session (dev image cargo, rootful podman).
notes: Same refusal rule as usr/lib/mios/mios_comments.py ('unmerged source index entry').

title: One shared helper per duplicated libexec/tool function instead of per-script copies
goal: Each helper the dead-code audit found copied between scripts has one implementation that every caller imports or sources, so a fix lands once.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN materialize-config-toml.py or mios-lldap-seed needs PostgreSQL settings THE SYSTEM SHALL call the one shared get_pg_config (usr/lib/mios/mios_db_config.py already carries one) and SHALL NOT define its own (audit items 28, 29).

WHEN mios-knowledge-search, mios-skills, mios-knowledge-add, mios-a2a-delegate or mios-finetune needs an embed call, PG row fetch, OWUI admin user id, A2A artifact text or finetune config THE SYSTEM SHALL import it from one shared module under usr/lib/mios/ instead of a per-script _kb_embed/_pg_rows/_admin_user_id/_extract_artifact_text/load_cfg copy (items 25, 30, 31, 32, 33, 34); _kb_embed's single-element endpoint loop goes away with it (item 25).

WHEN mios-flatpak/mios-flatpak-init emit an envelope or read a mios.toml scalar, and automation/77-composefs-verity.sh reads one, THE SYSTEM SHALL use one sourced bash helper (mios-toml-get / a mios_toml_scalar in automation/lib) instead of _emit_envelope, _toml_get, _read_mios_scalar and _ws7_scalar copies (items 49, 50, 55).

WHEN tools/check-runtime.py derives port keys THE SYSTEM SHALL use one function shared with the other gate (item 70, su_port_keys/pb_port_keys), and agent-pipe knowledge._rls_owner SHALL take the principal from the one server._turn_tenant path injected via knowledge.configure rather than re-reading the env (item 5).

WHEN a helper is lifted THE SYSTEM SHALL keep every default it carried resolving from mios.toml (Law 7); a literal fallback such as mios_db_config.get_pg_config's port 8600 SHALL come from [ports] rather than being copied into the shared module.

verification.positive_cmd: a new duplicate-helper test (registered in tools/ci-suites.py) asserts each named function is defined exactly once across usr/libexec/mios, usr/lib/mios, automation and tools and that every former copy-holder imports/sources it; existing suites: bash tests/run-suites.sh lint, agent-pipe test_mios_*.py, python3 tools/check-runtime.py
verification.negative_control_cmd: run the new test on the unfixed tree; then plant a second def get_pg_config into usr/libexec/mios/mios-lldap-seed (and a second _toml_get into mios-flatpak-init) in a scratch copy
verification.negative_expect: unfixed tree: FAIL naming every duplicated helper and its files; each plant: FAIL naming the planted file and function

notes: From the dead-code audit (audit-confirmed.json (session scratchpad)) items 5, 25, 28-34, 49, 50, 55, 70, all verdict confirmed. Confirm each pair's semantics match before merging (the audit checked bodies, not every caller's expectations). Regenerate manual-corpus.tsv after moving commented code. Audit item numbers are 0-based indexes into the session audit export (audit-confirmed.json); the file/symbol names in each criterion are the durable reference.

title: Clear pre-existing shellcheck findings in the audited shell scripts, then remove their dead code
goal: The shell scripts carrying audited dead code are shellcheck-clean, so removing that code is a reviewable diff that cannot hide a new finding.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN shellcheck runs (default severity) on usr/libexec/mios/capability-audit.sh, usr/libexec/mios/system-summary.sh, usr/lib/mios/log.sh and usr/libexec/mios/{mios-apps,mios-coderun-session,mios-env-probe,mios-flatpak-init,mios-flatpak-install,mios-gui,mios-screenshot,mios-steamcmd,mios-tool-clone,mios-window} THE SYSTEM SHALL report zero findings (119 before: 61 at warning severity, mostly SC2034/SC2155/SC2002/SC2012/SC2010/SC2015) without adding a disable directive that is not justified in a comment.

WHEN those files are clean THE SYSTEM SHALL no longer carry the audited dead code: capability-audit.sh's unused check_pass, five unused probe variables and write-only gpu_isolated loop (items 36, 37 -- or wire the values into the checklist echoes, as the verdict prefers), system-summary.sh check_status (item 43), log.sh mios_check_err/mios_check_skip (item 48), and the repeated set -u/set -eu line after set -euo pipefail in the ten libexec verbs (item 52).
WHEN mios assess / mios summary run THE SYSTEM SHALL produce the same report as before apart from the fixed gpu_isolated line.

verification.positive_cmd: shellcheck -f gcc <the 13 files> | wc -l -> 0; bash tests/run-suites.sh lint; bash usr/lib/mios/log.sh self-test; diff of capability-audit.sh/system-summary.sh output on one host before and after
verification.negative_control_cmd: shellcheck the same 13 files on the unfixed tree; plant `x=$(true)` unused in mios-gui and re-add `set -u` after set -euo pipefail in mios-apps in a scratch copy
verification.negative_expect: unfixed tree: 119 findings; plants: SC2034 in mios-gui, and the redundant-set check (or grep) names mios-apps

notes: From the dead-code audit (audit-confirmed.json (session scratchpad)) items 36, 37, 43, 48, 52. Counts measured on origin/main 554343ec with shellcheck default severity. Item 52 lists 34 scripts with the redundant set line; these ten are the ones with pre-existing findings. log.sh is sourced by deployed scripts: re-grep both repos for mios_check_ before deleting. Audit item numbers are 0-based indexes into the session audit export (audit-confirmed.json); the file/symbol names in each criterion are the durable reference.

title: Remove audited dead PowerShell in both repos and settle the mios-node Rust parity stubs
goal: Grandfathered PowerShell carries no dead functions or unused modules, the files mirrored into mios-bootstrap change identically in both repos (Law 15), and each unused mios-node method is deleted or explicitly kept for parity with its Python twin.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN build-mios.ps1 and Get-MiOS.ps1 change THE SYSTEM SHALL change them byte-identically in mios.git and mios-bootstrap.git (both copies identical at MiOS 554343ec / bootstrap 91dc899), removing Show-PostBootstrapMenu, Invoke-DataDiskBootstrap, Read-Model, Read-Password, Sync-RepoToDistro, Invoke-MiosPinToStart, Get-MiOSCenteredWindowPosition, Move-MiOSWindowToCenter and the one-element loop in Resolve-MiosTomlText (items 108-115, 129).

WHEN the mios.git-only PowerShell is cleaned THE SYSTEM SHALL drop mios-windows-export.ps1 Get-ImageManifest/Save-ImageLayers/Merge-LayersToTar/Compress-WithZstd and the unused $token (items 116-119), tools/lib/install-env.ps1 Write-MiosInstallEnv (item 120), and the unimported automation/lib modules MiOS.Toml, MiOS.Log, MiOS.Win Register-MiosScheduledTask, MiOS.Build/{Dashboard,Provision,Bake}, MiOS.Install/Agreement (items 122-128); MiOS.Console.psm1 SHALL instead become the one palette source that installation/mios-common.ps1 imports, replacing its hardcoded copy (item 121 verdict, task_1937, Law 7); because installation/mios-common.ps1 is mirrored to mios-bootstrap via mios.toml [bootstrap.sync].mirror_files, THE SYSTEM SHALL either add automation/lib/MiOS.Console.psm1 (at the path the import resolves to) to that mirror set so the bootstrap copy imports a module that exists there, or keep mios-common.ps1 self-contained by reading the palette from mios.toml [colors] -- never leave the bootstrap copy importing a missing module.

WHEN a src/mios-rs/mios-node method has no Rust caller (items 93-103: watchdog set/get_timeout, probe_node_capabilities, cgroups apply_limits/attach_pid, heartbeat record_announce/evict_peer/with_thresholds/assess_peer_health/active_peers, SessionCipher encrypt/decrypt_frame, ExecutionEngine with_hardware/hardware_controller, hardware with_custom_roots/get_mock_i2c_register, get_announce, ble get_credentials, TaskPriority::as_u8) THE SYSTEM SHALL either delete it or keep it with a doc comment naming the usr/libexec/mios/node/*.py twin it mirrors and a test that calls it.

verification.positive_cmd: MIOS_BOOTSTRAP_ROOT=../mios-bootstrap python3 tools/sync-bootstrap.py --check; cmp build-mios.ps1 ../mios-bootstrap/build-mios.ps1 && cmp Get-MiOS.ps1 ../mios-bootstrap/Get-MiOS.ps1; tests/powershell Pester suites (pwsh, where available); cargo test -p mios-node; git grep -w for each removed name returns nothing; cmp installation/mios-common.ps1 ../mios-bootstrap/installation/mios-common.ps1; in the bootstrap checkout, pwsh -c 'Import-Module' of every module mios-common.ps1 imports resolves
verification.negative_control_cmd: change build-mios.ps1 in mios.git only; separately re-add `function Read-Model {}` unused; remove a kept mios-node stub's parity test; in a scratch bootstrap copy, make mios-common.ps1 import automation/lib/MiOS.Console.psm1 without mirroring the module
verification.negative_expect: sync-bootstrap --check names build-mios.ps1 as diverged; the unused-function grep names Read-Model; cargo test / the parity check names the stub with no caller; the bootstrap import check names the missing MiOS.Console.psm1

notes: From the dead-code audit (audit-confirmed.json (session scratchpad)) items 93-103 and 108-129, all verdict confirmed. Mirrored PowerShell in mios-bootstrap ([bootstrap.sync].mirror_files plus the root scripts): build-mios.ps1, Get-MiOS.ps1 and installation/mios-common.ps1 (byte-identical in both repos); mios-windows-export.ps1, tools/lib/install-env.ps1 and automation/lib/*.psm1 are mios.git-only. Law 14: shrinking grandfathered PowerShell is in scope; adding PowerShell is not. Delete each module's characterization test with it, never on its own. Audit item numbers are 0-based indexes into the session audit export (audit-confirmed.json); the file/symbol names in each criterion are the durable reference.

title: Make agent-pipe dispatch take the global priority gate and endpoint semaphores in one order
goal: With the priority gate now engaged (b82baec6), no dispatch path can deadlock against another by acquiring the same locks in the opposite order.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN rr_enable is true and dispatches run on both the round-robin path and the non-RR/streaming path THE SYSTEM SHALL acquire _GLOBAL_PRIORITY_GATE, the endpoint semaphore and the lane semaphore in one documented order on every path (today agent_call.py's RR path takes endpoint -> lane -> gate inside _rr_run while the non-RR path and streaming.py take gate -> endpoint).
WHEN the gate is saturated by dispatches waiting on one endpoint THE SYSTEM SHALL still make progress (no dispatch waits on the gate while holding an endpoint permit).

verification.positive_cmd: an agent-pipe test that runs cap+N mixed RR and non-RR dispatches against one fake endpoint with rr_enable=true and a 1-permit endpoint semaphore, asserting all complete within a timeout; test_mios_sched.py; test_mios_agent_call.py
verification.negative_control_cmd: the same test on b82baec6 (before the fix)
verification.negative_expect: times out (deadlock) on the unfixed order; passes after

notes: Found by the adversarial review of the priority-gate fix (b82baec6). Latent while rr_enable defaults to false in mios.toml; becomes live the moment an operator enables round-robin.

title: Inject live callables into vram_scheduler.configure so VRAM admission and co-load gating actually run
goal: VRAM admission backpressure and co-load gating execute with real budget/residency data instead of failing on None and being swallowed.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN server.py configures vram_scheduler THE SYSTEM SHALL pass the real _over_global_ceiling, _is_warm, _resident_cached, _norm_model_tag, _reclaim_idle_vram, _blade_vram_budget and VRAM_BUDGET_MB / VRAM_COLOAD_* values (today globals().get(...) runs before those names are defined further down server.py, so all are injected as None and vram_scheduler._admit raises TypeError inside its except when admit_enable is true).

WHEN admit_enable is true and a request would exceed the VRAM ceiling THE SYSTEM SHALL queue or shed it per [dispatch], and SHALL NOT swallow a TypeError from a missing dependency (a missing injection fails configure loudly).
WHEN scheduler/vram.py needs host_stats, endpoint_key, blade pool, VRAM budget and admit ceilings THE SYSTEM SHALL receive them via configure as well; values come from mios.toml (Law 7).

verification.positive_cmd: test_server_import.py check that every vram_scheduler dependency is callable/non-None after server import; a test that admits past the ceiling with admit_enable=true and observes backpressure; test_mios_sched.py
verification.negative_control_cmd: the same checks on d234f32d (before the fix)
verification.negative_expect: dependency check names each None injection; the ceiling test sees no backpressure on the unfixed tree

notes: Found while fixing the [dispatch] freeze (b82baec6): VRAM_RECLAIM_IDLE now resolves from mios.toml but has no runtime effect until this lands. Turning it on changes runtime admission behavior; verify against a live lane.

Every crate in both workspaces shall map to exactly one row, and there shall be 6-8 binaries. `mios-gate` shall fail when a crate is unmapped, a top-level table has zero or several owning modules, or an output lacks a check. `[build.native.categories]` (`mios.toml:1894-1925`), the `55-native-build.sh:16` literal list and `[laws.projection_registry]` (`mios.toml:2312`) shall be projected from it and guarded by regenerate-and-diff (Law 8).
