title: M7 F6: dynamic GPU arbiter -- a native state machine moves the dGPU between the inference VM and mios-xbox, with vLLM sleep, light-lane failover and rollback (WS-VFIO | P1 | L)
goal: M7 (docs/design/mios-field-hypervisor.md; Atlas https://claude.ai/artifact/3NcyFYkcsskVpfp4KurUoA). [metal.gpu].arbitration = "dynamic" enables it. [ports].arbiter (8760) is the policy arbiter, not this: the GPU arbiter uses a virtio-vsock request to L1 and a local socket, no port. vLLM sleep mode (/sleep, /wake_up; brief P2-9) replaces the spec's SIGSTOP plus manual CUDA reset. While the dGPU is away /v1 goes to lanes off it, such as [ports].cpu_node (the gaming-immune CPU lane); llm-light is CUDA-built and drains too on a single-dGPU host. The drain across nested MiOS containers is task_3623. Code lives in the runtime domain module, not a new binary.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN a gaming request arrives THE SYSTEM SHALL drain the heavy lane with vLLM /sleep, route /v1 to lanes that do not use the dGPU, unbind the guest driver, have L1 detach the dGPU from the MiOS VM and attach it to mios-xbox, each step checked before the next.

WHEN the guest exits THE SYSTEM SHALL return the dGPU to the MiOS VM, rebind, /wake_up and restore heavy-lane routing; WHEN any step fails THE SYSTEM SHALL roll back to the AI state, and at no point attach the dGPU to two guests or leave /v1 unanswered.

verification.positive_cmd: the arbiter's tests run the full AI -> draining -> released -> gaming -> returning -> AI cycle against mocked sysfs, QMP and /v1
verification.negative_control_cmd: delete the rollback branch for a failed rebind (planted) and inject that failure; the test must fail naming the stranded state

title: M7 F8: single-live lease per Quadlet -- exactly one live instance across L2 and the fleet, paused standbys, failover promotion, reusing the k3s Lease (WS-BLADE | P1 | L)
goal: M7 (docs/design/mios-field-hypervisor.md; Atlas https://claude.ai/artifact/3NcyFYkcsskVpfp4KurUoA). Operator ruling 2026-10-09: every MiOS image carries the full set of Quadlets; hosted duplicates are migrated or paused, so no duplicate is ever live and contending; a paused copy takes over on failure, locally or on a remote blade. Reuse, do not invent: a k3s Lease (coordination.k8s.io) per Quadlet keeps ADR-0017 D1's boundary (k3s owns containers; a Lease is only a lock); Pacemaker clone-max=1 is the alternative if the operator prefers it. Needs one k3s cluster across blades (task_934).
acceptance_criteria: WHEN two or more MiOS instances (L2 VMs, nested MiOS containers, the WSL2 MiOS) carry a Quadlet THE SYSTEM SHALL run it only where the Quadlet's lease is held and keep every other copy paused (podman pause), with lease duration and renewal from SSOT.
WHEN the holder stops renewing THE SYSTEM SHALL pause it before the lease expires, and a standby SHALL take the lease and resume, locally or on a remote blade, within the [blade.collapse] dwell.

verification.positive_cmd: two L2 VMs carrying the same Quadlet: exactly one holds the Lease and runs, the other is paused; stop the holder and the standby resumes within the lease duration
verification.negative_control_cmd: disable pause-on-lost-renewal (planted) and partition the holder; the fleet probe sees two live instances and fails

title: M7 F8: single-live gate -- a native check fails when one Quadlet has two live instances, in the rendered placement or in a running fleet (WS-BLADE | P1 | S)

Native mios-gate code (no new Python or shell).
acceptance_criteria: WHEN the placement plan or a fleet probe shows a Quadlet live on more than one MiOS instance (L2 VMs and nested MiOS containers alike) THE SYSTEM SHALL fail, naming the Quadlet and every live host; paused copies SHALL NOT count as live.

verification.positive_cmd: mios-gate single-live over the rendered placement plan and the fleet probe passes
verification.negative_control_cmd: start a second, unpaused copy of one Quadlet on another L2 (or plant two live hosts for it in a placement fixture)

WHEN a local move is requested THE SYSTEM SHALL pause the source copy, hand over the lease and resume the target on the same L1, with the Quadlet's data reachable from both.

verification.negative_control_cmd: plant a placement naming an L2 that does not exist, then one whose host lacks a required capability

title: M7 F8: promotable core services -- an SSOT list of the services and modules that may move up from an L3 Quadlet to a native unit of an L2 image, the promotion mechanism and its gate (WS-BLADE | P2 | M)
